title: Counter
description: A huge number that counts or rolls like an odometer from one value to the next (several steps allowed: 51 → 79 → 70), with a prefix/suffix (k, %, $) and a small label. For stats, specs and results.

values.description: Numbers to count through, in order (the first is the start).

suffix.description: After the number, e.g. k, %, x (empty: none).

label.description: Small mono label under the number (empty: none).

style.description: odometer: digit wheels roll; count: the digits change in place.

weight.description: Font weight of the number (the Inter face).
